c74object.name: evi_control_lpg_buchla
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Envelope and control circuit wrapper for voltage control of Rf
c74object.description:
evi_control_lpg_buchla is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
Analog modelled vactrol envelope and control circuit for the voltage control of the evi_lpg_buchla.gendsp frequency inlet. Also embedded in the MSP abstraction evi.lpg~.

constructor.digest: { arguments={}, inlets={ ping, vactrol, vactrol, offset, scaler, sweep } }

geninlet.name: ping
geninlet.digest: Ping the control circuit. Once connected to an LPG (evi_lpg_buchla.gendsp) audio rate ping to attack the filter gate.

geninlet.name: vactrol
geninlet.digest: Rise. Vactrol envelope rise time (ping attack time) in ms.

geninlet.name: vactrol
geninlet.digest: Fall. Vactrol envelope fall time (ping decay time) in ms.

geninlet.name: offset
geninlet.digest: 0..1. Offset (add to) the voltage input to the LPG. Part of the control circuit that engages the voltage (frequency) of the filter/gate.

geninlet.name: scaler
geninlet.digest: 0..1. Scale (multiply) the voltage input to the LPG. Part of the control circuit that engages the voltage (frequency) of the filter/gate.

geninlet.name: sweep
geninlet.digest: 0..1. Amount of sweep range of the voltage input to the LPG. Part of the control circuit that engages the voltage (frequency) of the filter/gate.

attribute.name: offsetsmooth
attribute.description: If > 0, smooths the 'offset' control (inlet 4) by this amount in ms.

attribute.name: response
attribute.description: Select 0, 1, 2. To quote the paper, '...it makes little difference'. But sometimes it does make a difference. This control switches between slow..long response times for the voltage input into the control circuit shaper.

attribute.name: scalersmooth
attribute.description: If > 0, smooths the 'scale' control (inlet 5) by this amount in ms.

attribute.name: sweepsmooth
attribute.description: If > 0, smooths the 'sweep' control (inlet 6) by this amount in ms.

attribute.name: vactrolcontroldamp
attribute.description: Low shelving filter damp, optionally maps between V_c and V_b (default bypassed). To quote the paper, '...it makes little difference'. 0 = no damping (default, bypassed), 1 = fully damped. Also see @vactrolcontrolhz.

attribute.name: vactrolcontrolhz
attribute.description: Low shelving filter frequency in Hz, optionally maps between V_c and V_b (default bypassed). To quote the paper, '...it makes little difference'. Also see @vactrolcontroldamp.

attribute.name: vactrolscalar
attribute.description: Vactrol Envelope Output Multiplier. Effectively gain the pinging envelope into the control circuit to accentuate the ping. Otherwise should be '1'.
